description: Fork of exp174 (val_bpb=1.6478, 481M). Single change: qk_tph 384 -> 192 (halved). Saves ~113M in the 6 qk_joint LUTs (226.5M -> 113.25M); total 481M -> ~368M (-23.5%). Tests how much qk capacity is actually needed in exp174's setup. Pair coverage in qk space drops 152% -> 76% (now <100%, ~25% of pairs unsampled). Launch with SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_FORWARD_KERNEL=tc SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_BACKWARD_KERNEL=bf16.
